question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you know there would be trouble with the Wilson High kids?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I always thought it was just an excuse to have parties and parades.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, you at least have to admit that you love the fireworks. Everyone always looks forward to the fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know, we actually didn't get any fireworks for the party...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No wonder you don't appreciate the Fourth of July. Half of the fun is the fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, the stand we went to was sold out!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry. Just wait until the party tonight. I'll bring over some amazing fireworks. I promise you'll be impressed.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aw, that's sweet. Okay, I'll be looking forward to it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oooh! The parade is starting!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Let's go look at all the pretty floats!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: See you guys later.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bye...
Linda and Amanda walk away. Howard turns to Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay! We've got to find the best fireworks money can buy!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, I saw what was going on there. You think Linda's pretty, don't you? You're falling for her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not the point! I made her a promise. And I'm going to keep it, even if it means I have to search this entire town!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmm... We can't go back to my house to get any of the fireworks there... My parents might catch us. We'll have to go to the local fireworks stands.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know... Do you think there will be any left at the stands? It's pretty late to be buying fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, but...
Suddenly, over Jacob's shoulder, Howard spots Kay and Kel sneaking towards them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Behind you! It's the twins!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Say 'cheese'!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm out of here!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Right behind you!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Did you get a picture of him?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No luck.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me neither.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Then let's go! We have to keep following him!
Eventually, Howard and Jacob find a fireworks stand in the middle of a parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I hate to say 'I told you so', but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. I can't believe how long it took us to find this stand...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And it looks like they don't have much left.
Next to the stand, there's a big cardboard box labeled 'High Quality Fireworks'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, let's dig through what's left and see what we can come up with...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember, pick out the best ones. Don't be fooled by the prices. Sometimes they mark up cheap fireworks since most people don't know the difference.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sparklers, roman candles, and spinners... Not bad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is a good start... At least we've got enough fireworks to bring to the party...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But we're going to need something better to impress Linda.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Heh. You really have a thing for her, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... Come on, let's figure out where we can get some really cool fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Let's see... I bought... `The Friedom Burner?` This one couldn't even spell the name right...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's see... I bought... [color=#e23b3b][i]The Friedom Burner?[/i][/color] This one couldn't even spell the name right...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This box of sparklers is labeled `Spacklers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This box of sparklers is labeled [color=#e23b3b][i]Spacklers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is pathetic! We can't show up with this! We'd be laughed out of the party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We really need better fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hmm...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well... There's only one guy to see if we need to find something that's hard to get.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: If it can be gotten, Andy will know who to get it from.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are we waiting for?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It isn't that easy... I happen to know that Andy is at a party right now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So? Let's crash it.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: At this party, I think we'd... Stand out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well... You'll see. Just stick close and follow my lead...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The Fourth of July is awesome! Maybe you never got the full Fourth of July experience.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How often do you get a chance to celebrate rule-breaking and independence?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not to mention getting to set off explosives.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heh. That's a funny way of looking at it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm not crazy! Come on, you've got to admit that the Fourth of July can't compete with `real` holidays.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not crazy! Come on, you've got to admit that the Fourth of July can't compete with [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] holidays.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know what I mean, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `No, I'm afraid I don't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No, I'm afraid I don't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Like, Halloween... Or Valentine's Day... Or... Uh... The Fall Equinox...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stop right there. Are you `serious?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop right there. Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]serious?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ha ha... Linda, you shouldn't mess with Howard like that!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I didn't think he'd believe me! I guess you really like the Fourth of July, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's go.
The twins run up to Howard and Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Wait! You can't leave!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You're grounded!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And what are you two going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Kay! Take a picture on your cell phone!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! Then we can blackmail Howard anytime we want!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: If he doesn't do whatever we say, we can show the picture to Mom and Dad!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yikes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'd better get out of here!
The boys dash off!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No fair running!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Come back!
Jacob and Howard run until they get to the parade site.
Around them, a crowd of people has lined the streets, waiting for the parade to begin.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like we managed to ditch the twins.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Finally! Now to find our friends...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! Jacob! Over here!
Amanda comes over with another girl in tow.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Have either of you met my neighbor, Linda? She's helping me organize the big party tonight!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hi.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: When is this parade going to start? We've been here for almost an hour!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can't believe everyone is waiting this long for a parade.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's the Fourth of July... Of course everyone wants to see the parade.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: To be honest, I never really got what was so great about the Fourth of July.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean, it's kind of a waste of a holiday...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's in the summer, so we don't even get a day off from school.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here goes.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like the coast is clear...
Howard carefully...
And quietly...
Gets to the door without being spotted!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Nice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See? Nothing to it.
Howard opens the window...
He climbs out ever so carefully...
But slips and falls off the roof!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oof!
Jacob runs up!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You all right, man? You fell pretty hard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My knee is still bleeding! I thought you were going to help me!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh, I said I'd help. I didn't say I'd catch you as you fall awkwardly out of your window.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What did you want me to do? Dive in front of you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That probably would have been more helpful than laughing.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah... Sorry about that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You weren't even standing outside the window! You were all the way at the street!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I didn't know you were going to jump out right then... Anyway, I helped you limp out to the street, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come on, we're wasting time. Think you can stand now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh. Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Here, let me help you up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: No more arguing! You're grounded! Go to your room!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm going under protest!
The next day Howard restlessly paces in his room...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stupid grounding...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe they want me to miss the Fourth of July...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The parade... The party tonight... There's no way I'm skipping all of that.
Just then, Howard's door opens to reveal the twins!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what are you two doing in my room?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Heh. You caught us.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Not bad, big brother.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, twins, you know you aren't allowed in here... Not after the raccoon incident.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We thought you'd like Mr. Patches...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You locked a wild raccoon inside my room! It made a nest out of my pillow! I'm still finding fur balls in my sock drawer...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But, but, we weren't even planning anything `this` time!
nodes.text_bbcode: But, but, we weren't even planning anything [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] time!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Really!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Really, really!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure... Like I'll believe that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get out of here, you two.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hmph.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hmph.
Howard's cell phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Howard! Are you ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... I just haven't decided how to get out.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come on, you're just sneaking out. It isn't brain surgery.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It'll be easy. Just climb out the window. I'll help you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Out the window? That's silly. I could just sneak out the front door and hope no one's paying attention...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sounds risky. It only takes one person to bust you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe. Look, I'll see you outside my house.
Howard hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. I'm going out the...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe you'd ground me for the entire month!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Really? You think that's harsh? Just wait till you have to replant our lawn! We've only just begun to punish you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gulp...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Do you even know what's written in the Constitution?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know that it's about freedom from tyranny!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that's what the Fourth of July is about too! It's about standing up for what you believe in!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: The kid makes a good point...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: The Revolutionary War wasn't fought because of teenage delinquency! This has nothing to do with tyranny!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard, but your mother also makes a good point.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But don't you think an entire month is too harsh?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well... If you're good, we'll consider only grounding you for the next week.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But... I'll still have to miss everything tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can ground me for a month, but just give me tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It took an hour for the firemen to put out the blaze! And I don't think the Watsons ever found their dog...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I know I messed up.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: That doesn't begin to cover it! The news crew on our lawn is calling this a low-grade forest fire! You put our entire neighborhood in danger!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: And on top of all that, you ran away instead of trying to get help!
And so, later that evening...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard! I can't believe you did something so irresponsible.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: We're very disappointed in you. Do you realize how much trouble you've caused?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is my fault! The least I can do is call the fire department before my whole house burns down!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry... You're on your own, man.
Howard pulls out his cell phone and calls the fire department.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hello? I need to report a fire...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good idea!
Howard and Jacob run down the street...
...And right into Howard's parents!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What's going on here? What are you two running away from?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Is our house on fire?!
Just then, there's a crashing sound at the other end of the beach!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That'll teach them to leave us out of their stupid old tea party!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! I bet the fish and seals and otters will like all of their tea...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Tee hee!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Those... Those little ragamuffins just threw our tea into the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Stop! Stop those children!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The tea! The twins just ruined the Bostine tea party!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, at least they created a diversion!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes indeed, this party is an absolute delight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But unfortunately my associate and I must be leaving.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh, that's too bad. I do hope you had a good time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... We have to... Um... Get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You sound as if you're attempting to escape...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I... I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh, I'm happy to hear that!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I... I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's a real hootenanny!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I just don't understand!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Are you enjoying yourself at the party?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why, yes! This party is great! It's absolutely...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Why, thank you!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You're... Quite strange.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You're... Quite strange.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Crumbulent! You're looking very crumbulent!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Is that even a word?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's see... I should compliment her outfit!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I may say so, Penelope, you are looking very...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: That's an odd way to put it...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh! How delightful!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: That's an odd way to put it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're... Uh... Comrades!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: That's... And odd way to put it.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: First, what you need to do is head over to the Wilson side of town. Drive east until you find a bus stop...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You'll see a man wearing a plaid vest.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: The man's name is Fabian. He will speak with an unfamiliar accent. `DO NOT` look him in the eye. Tell him that you are a `mongoose` looking for a `wolf`.
nodes.text_bbcode: The man's name is Fabian. He will speak with an unfamiliar accent. [color=#e23b3b][i]DO NOT[/i][/color] look him in the eye. Tell him that you are a [color=#e23b3b][i]mongoose[/i][/color] looking for a [color=#e23b3b][i]wolf[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: He will reply by listing a series of `prime numbers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He will reply by listing a series of [color=#e23b3b][i]prime numbers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Remember `every third number`, and that will give you the address.
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember [color=#e23b3b][i]every third number[/i][/color], and that will give you the address.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Drive to that address. You will see a neon sign of a `purple parrot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Drive to that address. You will see a neon sign of a [color=#e23b3b][i]purple parrot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: There you should find the fireworks you're looking for.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Got it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Accented man... Purple parrot... I think I've got it all.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Then I can be of no further assistance to you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Andy!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Good luck, both of you.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I can assure you that you'll need it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, this is great. We just need to head over to the Wilson High side of town and find those fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to do this? The Wilson High kids aren't going to be happy if they see us on their side of town...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not afraid of them. Come on, we just have to get out of here...
As both boys turn to go, they run into an unfamiliar girl!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Why, hello. I don't believe I've met you two before. I'm Penelope Bostine. I suppose you know my brother?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh oh... Better do some smooth-talking to keep our cover and get out of here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's just hope I remember my British slang...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why, yes! I do know your brother! He and I are...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Money? Are you trying to buy me off?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa... Calm down, man. I just wanted to compensate you for your trouble.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, we're asking you for a favor. Isn't it polite to offer something in return?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well, you can keep your money.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But since you seem like a good guy, I guess I can give you some information.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I need the fireworks to impress this girl...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I've been there before.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Since it's for a good cause, I'll tell you everything I know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'd better get out of here before he gets back.
Suddenly, Howard and Jacob hear the sounds of a scuffle!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hey! Let us in!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Sorry, no children are allowed at this tea party.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha... Looks like the twins got kicked out.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But our brother is in there! His name is Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh oh. We'd better not stick around here much longer...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't worry. I think I see the guy we're looking for. Hey, Andy!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We need help finding fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And not just any fireworks. We need the best fireworks around.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Looking for bigger and better fireworks, huh? I used to be like you...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But that was years ago... Before the accident...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Accident? What accident?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: The Fireworks Massacre of Centerscore Shopping Plaza! I lost my eye that night...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: And I was one of the lucky ones...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wait... I thought you lost your eye in a slingshot accident...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You ask me for help, and now you're calling me a `liar?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You ask me for help, and now you're calling me a [color=#e23b3b][i]liar?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gulp...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You're on your own. Why would I help you get fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know why. Because of...

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Ah, jolly good indeed. I can see we're going to get along famously.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Er... Yes, famously!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: I'll run off and fetch that for you. Part of being a good host, you know.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Ah, if I see Penelope, I'll bring her back along with the food.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Ah, not a tea and crumpets man, eh?

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: That's a bit odd... I thought we told everyone this was a tea party...
Archibald looks at the two of you suspiciously.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Are you sure you're at the right party?

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Maybe I'd better fetch Penelope so she can make the proper introductions.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How proper.
Archibald leaves them to find his sister.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: As you might have guessed, I am Archibald Bostine. I suppose you must be friends of Penelope.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ah, yes, that's right. Penelope.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: I really must remind my dear sister that it's terribly rude of her to not introduce all of our guests.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Think nothing of it! An honest mistake.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Well, now that you're here, is there anything I can get for you? Some tea and crumpets, perhaps?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
The boys sneak around, skirting the edges of the party.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh... I think we kind of stand out...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Quiet! Just a little bit more...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Where are we even going? To the sand castle? We need to look for Andy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know that, but...
Howard bumps into one of the party guests!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: I say, good chaps, what sort of sport is this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yikes!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: You wouldn't be attempting to gain illicit entrance into our little soiree, would you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... No! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: I see... Well, if you're certain you aren't sneaks...

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Welcome to the party!
The boys make their way through the party, engaging in proper small talk.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why, what a splendid tea party.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The best I've seen in years. Wouldn't you agree?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Er... Indubitably.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Why, hello there!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Welcome to our little soiree.
A short drive later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what's going on with this party? Why were you so worried?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a `tea party` that a couple of British foreign-exchange students are throwing.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a [color=#e23b3b][i]tea party[/i][/color] that a couple of British foreign-exchange students are throwing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's by invitation only! They blocked off the beach for miles for this!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that means we're going to have to sneak around.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Either we sneak around or we try to blend in. There's a ton of people here, so they might not even notice a couple extra guests.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It's your call.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Some tea may or may not have ended up in the ocean...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That part wasn't my fault! The twins did that!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're trying to blame your `little sisters`? You're terrible!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're trying to blame your [color=#3b78e2][i]little sisters[/i][/color]? You're terrible!

nodes.text: But before Howard and Linda get a chance to go outside, they hear Jacob running through the house!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: They're coming! Get ready!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Who's coming?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It's the British!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: The British are coming! The British are coming!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Penelope and Archibald figured out that we crashed their tea party! Now they're retaliating by crashing this party!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Retaliating? Just for crashing a party?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, it's pretty dark outside. Why don't we set some of them off?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was crazy! We had to sneak into this British tea party, and then we had to drive to a random bus stop...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There was a guy named Fabian, and a purple parrot sign...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow, I guess these fireworks must be pretty amazing, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're the best in town!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but I've been looking forward to seeing them all day. I feel just like a kid again!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thank you for going through so much trouble to get them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you're happy, then it was completely worth it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was no trouble at all.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! Maybe now she thinks I don't care about her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, they weren't `that` easy to get.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, they weren't [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] easy to get.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I thought you just said...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I meant... What I meant was...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... You'll really... Like these fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey...What's that behind Stiletto?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no! How did the twins get here?!
The twins sneak up behind Stiletto...
And swarm around her, taking her down!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Leave our brother alone!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Ouch! My knee! You little brats! Where did you come from?!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Did you just `bite` me? Ow!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just [color=#3b78e2][i]bite[/i][/color] me? Ow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, thanks...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Say cheese!
Kay and Kel snap pictures of Howard on their cell phones!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Twins! This isn't the time for messing around!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You shouldn't have followed me here!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We didn't follow you.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We just hid in your trunk!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You shouldn't be here at all! This place is dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've got to get you two out of here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get to the car right now!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hmph.
Howard grabs the fireworks...
Then he runs to the car!
Jacob climbs into the car and Howard drives off!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That weird lady is following us...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I guess we didn't bite her hard enough...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You `bit` Stiletto? No wonder she's so upset...
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]bit[/i][/color] Stiletto? No wonder she's so upset...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We'll have to lose them! Howard, you'd better be able to pull off some fancy driving...
Howard dodges cars and weaves through traffic.
After a few sharp turns and some fast driving...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There! There's the mall! Now we're back on the Centerscore High side of town.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: They won't follow us over here. We're home free!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And it looks like we'll be just in time for the party! There's Linda's house right there.
Howard dodges and weaves through traffic...
And runs straight into a telephone pole!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My car!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, at least we don't have to worry about the Wilson kids... They just drove off laughing...
Everyone climbs out of the car and starts walking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess it's a good thing we aren't too far from the party.
After twenty minutes of walking...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How far away `are` we?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How far away [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] we?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Calm down... The party's right over there.
They walk into Linda's house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Finally! I was starting to think we'd never get here!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm going to go say hi to Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See you later.
Howard turns to the twins.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, twins, I'd really appreciate it if you didn't snitch on me.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Aw... We weren't really going to tell on you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We wouldn't do something like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes... Yes you would. You do all the time!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, we weren't going to this time!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Besides, you didn't let the crazy lady hurt us.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And if we tell on you, then we won't get to stay at the party...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, deal. But don't eat too many cupcakes...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Sorry, but we really can't make any promises.
The twins run off to the dessert table as Linda approaches Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! You made it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course. And we brought fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And... Your little sisters?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Candy!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry about that.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, no problem. They're adorable, and it's nice that you care about them so much.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... The twins are all right when they're not causing trouble.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So, let's see those fireworks you've been talking about.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I hope it wasn't too much trouble to get them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what you're thinking, but there's no way I could ever hurt a girl!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Then I guess this is going to be easy!
Stiletto shoves Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oof...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This girl is crazy... I'd better slowly back away without making any sudden movements...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You think I'll go easy on you because you're a girl? No way!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Ha ha... This is going to be more fun than I thought...
Stiletto shoves Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oof...
And then she shoves him again!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, my turn!
Howard tries to tackle Stiletto!
But he misses and hits the ground!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Ha ha... Pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Must... Salvage... Dignity...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: While... Backing... Away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I guess you've had enough!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, I don't like your `face!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I don't like your [color=#e23b3b][i]face![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jacob pushes Skazz!
Skazz pushes Jacob back!
The two of them wrestle on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: As for you...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Are we going to beat them up or what?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Back off, man.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I don't like your `attitude`, pretty-boy!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't like your [color=#e23b3b][i]attitude[/i][/color], pretty-boy!

nodes.text: Howard and Jacob spot a Wilson High boy at the far end of the parking lot.
They approach him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey. We heard from Fabian that you might have some fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Fabian sent you? Are you the mongoose?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Yes! You're the... wolf?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You got it! So, you want to buy fireworks, right?
Steve pulls a handful of fireworks out of his backpack.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I've got everything you need. How about `The Freedom-Maker?` Or `The Sparkling Silver Revolution?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've got everything you need. How about [color=#e23b3b][i]The Freedom-Maker?[/i][/color] Or [color=#e23b3b][i]The Sparkling Silver Revolution?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, we need something with more firepower!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I guess I could part with `The Balkan Powder Keg`... I'll even throw in `The Screaming Stars Fountain.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I could part with [color=#e23b3b][i]The Balkan Powder Keg[/i][/color]... I'll even throw in [color=#e23b3b][i]The Screaming Stars Fountain.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey. Don't try to rip us off. Let's see your best merchandise.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I guess you really know your fireworks. Don't worry, I've got just the thing.
Steve reaches into his backpack and pulls out...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: `The Widow-Maker!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The Widow-Maker![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's... It's beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I thought it was just a myth!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Just be careful when you set it off. And remember, if you burn anything down, you never saw me.
Howard takes all of the fireworks and puts them into a bag.
Just then, a couple of cars pull up...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Oh, it's the auto shop kids.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Steve! What are those Centerscore High kids doing on our side of town?!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You guys are from Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You didn't tell me that! Now Stiletto's going to be mad...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I'm out of here!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What are you Centerscore losers doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We were just buying some fireworks. We don't want any trouble.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: If you didn't want trouble, you shouldn't have come to this side of town.

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: You fools! Find your own way to the purple parrot!
Fabian storms off.
Howard and Jacob climb back in the car.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We blew it! What are we going to do now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... We know that we need to find the purple parrot neon sign...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So let's just drive around until we find one! It has to be here somewhere...
Hours of driving later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There! There's a purple neon sign!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry, man, that's not a parrot... That's an armadillo.
More hours later...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a parrot, but that sign is definitely red...
And finally...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There! There it is! It's `purple`, it's a `parrot`... This is the place!
nodes.text_bbcode: There! There it is! It's [color=#e23b3b][i]purple[/i][/color], it's a [color=#e23b3b][i]parrot[/i][/color]... This is the place!

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: Thirteen... Seventeen... Nineteen!

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: That is all. Good day, sirrrs.
Howard and Jacob climb back in the car.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, that was... Interesting...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I guess we're going to address 1311 on 19th street.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There it is! 1311 on 19th street, and the building has a neon sign of a purple parrot, just like Andy said.
Soon...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: We've been driving east for almost an hour...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Couldn't Andy just give us the name of the street it was on?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Hey! There's the bus stop!

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: Now we just need to find Fabian...

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: Arrre you the mongoose?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Yes! I'm a mongoose looking for a wolf!

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: Get down before someone spots you!

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: Two... Three... Thirteen...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's listing the prime numbers!

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: Five... Seven... Eleven...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wonder why Andy told us not to look in his eyes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Kind of makes it hard `not` to look...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Kind of makes it hard [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] to look...

nodes.text: Almost against his will, Howard chances a glance!

nodes.speaker: Fabian
nodes.text: What arrre you looking at?!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Young man, you're grounded for the rest of the month!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... The Fourth of July is tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My friends are having a party! And there's the parade!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, you'll just have to celebrate the Fourth of July in your room... Without television... Or music... Or video games...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What... What about fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: No fireworks, no parties, no seeing your friends!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's... That's...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come on, let's get out of here and get those fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is this how you celebrate the Fourth of July? By bullying some British kids?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? No, it wasn't like that!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure. Like I'll believe that.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh... Should I... Give you two some privacy?
At that moment, Archibald and Penelope walk up!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: So we meet again!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What... What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You ruined our party, so we're taking over yours!
After a short scuffle...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is the worst Fourth of July ever! I totally can't believe we just got thrown out of our own party!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I told you it was a stupid holiday.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is all my fault...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes! Yes it is!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We're never inviting you to another one of our parties!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Come on, Linda. Let's get out of here.
Poor Howard! You're not going to leave him like this, are you?
Save him from this terrible fate!
And if you get a perfect score, there just might be a bonus scene somewhere around here...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: The fire truck is still out there carting away what's left of our lawn!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: At least I called the fire department! Don't I get points for that?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I suppose you think we should be thankful the entire house didn't burn down!
Want to find out how Howard met Linda and where it all started?
Play as Howard in this special Fourth of July interlude episode of Surviving High School!
It's the night before the Fourth of July! What could be better than setting off a few fireworks a little bit early?
The boy in front of us is just about done preparing a huge stack of fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is going to be great!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, Howard. Having a pre-Fourth of July celebration?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What can I say? I take the Fourth of July seriously.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All that's left to do now is light the fuse...
Howard lights the fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now to just...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Back up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To a safe distance...
The fireworks explode!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wait... Is your lawn supposed to be burning like that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I wasn't planning on the grass catching fire... Or that tree...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Maybe we should get out of here!

The boy in front of us is just about done preparing a huge stack of fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is going to be great!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, Howard. Having a pre-Fourth of July celebration?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What can I say? I take the Fourth of July seriously.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All that's left to do now is light the fuse...
Howard lights the fireworks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now to just...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Back up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To a safe distance...
The fireworks explode!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wait... Is your lawn supposed to be burning like that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I wasn't planning on the grass catching fire... Or that tree...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Maybe we should get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: Ah, Penelope! I see you've found your 'friends'.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: My friends?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I've only just met these two.

nodes.speaker: Archibald
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Let's get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice meeting you two! See you later!
Howard and Jacob dash off, knocking over tables and chairs as they run!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hurry!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: They're right behind us!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jacob! Stop looking back! Watch out for the buffet table!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What table?
Jacob knocks over the entire table of food and tumbles onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ow...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on! Get up, man!
Howard helps Jacob up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm good! I'm good.
Howard and Jacob run back to Howard's car.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That was a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, well, all the more reason not to stick around here.
Great job! Howard and Linda certainly had a happy Fourth of July.
You played a good game, but you didn't get a perfect score!
Try again to see if you can win the bonus scene!
They head outside.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is going to be great.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ready? I'm lighting the fuses.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's see these fireworks.
The fuse burns down...
The fireworks explode in a spectacular display of red and blue flames and sparks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow... `The Widow-Maker` was amazing! The flames were five feet tall!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... [color=#e23b3b][i]The Widow-Maker[/i][/color] was amazing! The flames were five feet tall!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ha ha... You really know a lot about fireworks, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `The Widow-Maker` is legendary!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The Widow-Maker[/i][/color] is legendary!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, you have to admit that you're at least a little bit impressed.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay... I admit it... You were right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I have to say, you seem to have put a lot of thought into all of this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah, you know, I like the Fourth of July...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is that it? Are you sure you weren't trying to... Oh, I don't know, impress me with fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Of course not! That would be ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Right?
Linda gives Howard a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think it's sweet.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, you still have a few sparklers left.
Linda lights the sparklers and hands one to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on. Let's go share these with Amanda and Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I bet they could use a little Fourth of July fun.
Linda and Howard head back towards the party together...
Wow! A perfect game!
Playing like that deserves a bonus scene.
Later that night at the party...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Mmm. Those cupcakes were yummy.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Not as good as the cookies.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What should we do now?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well... We could always find Howard...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, no matter what we do, he can't tell on us because he'll get in trouble too!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let's find him!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I bet he's outside with Linda!
And so...
The twins sneak up as Linda is trying on Howard's hat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm usually not much of a hat person...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I'll make an exception for this one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You look cute!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard loves Linda! Howard loves Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry, Linda... Maybe we should just ignore them...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard loves Linda! Howard loves Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Here, let me handle this...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, girls, did you see the squirrels in the back yard?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `Squirrels?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Squirrels?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, there are a lot of them! You should go look! You might even be able to catch one...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: `Yay`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yay[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The twins run off to the backyard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow... I can't believe you got them to leave!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... You don't know the twins. They'll probably catch an army of squirrels...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There are no squirrels.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There aren't any animals in our backyard... Not a single one... But the twins won't figure that out for a couple of hours.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha... Okay, not bad. Not bad at all.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I have three older sisters, and when I was younger, I `loved` to annoy them.
nodes.text_bbcode: I have three older sisters, and when I was younger, I [color=#3b78e2][i]loved[/i][/color] to annoy them.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They came up with more than a few ways to keep me busy, and between bothering them and figuring out their plans, I know every trick in the book.
Looks like the twins might have finally met their match...
Well, that's it for this bonus scene. Thanks for playing this episode of 'Surviving High School'!
And happy Fourth of July!
They head outside.s

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is going to be great.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ready? I'm lighting the fuses.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's see these fireworks.
The fuse burns down...
And...
Nothing happens!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man! That guy must have sold me defective fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... It's not all bad. You still have a couple of sparklers.
Linda lights two of the sparklers and hands one to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: These are kind of fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess so...
Just then, Howard and Linda see a car driving by...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That car looks familiar...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard?! Is that you?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... Is that... Is that your mom?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Howard! You're supposed to be grounded!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I guess I'd better go.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See you later, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Bye...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is that Howard getting pulled away by his parents?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee... That's funny!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's too bad... I was really starting to like him.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He's, like, never going to live this down.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... Poor Howard.
Poor Howard indeed! This ending could have been much better!
Try again. Besides, there's a bonus scene waiting for you at the end of a perfect game!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We might have knocked over their buffet table...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! That's terrible!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was an accident!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Do you really expect me to believe that?! If it was an accident, then why did they come after you?!
